claims: St. John's University is a private university.
St. John's University is a Roman Catholic university.
St. John's University is a Vincentian university.
St. John's University was founded in 1870.
St. John's University is primarily located in Queens, New York City.
St. John's University has international campuses in Rome, Paris, and Seville.
St. John's University has Division I athletics.
St. John's University's athletics team is named Red Storm.
St. John’s University has its main campus in Queens, NY.
St. John’s University has additional locations in Staten Island, Manhattan, and Oakdale, NY.
St. John’s University offers over 100 undergraduate and graduate programs.
St. John’s University competes in the NCAA Division I Big East Conference.

Saint John's University (Minnesota) is located in Collegeville, MN.
